dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehh, is that you, Dopey Dazzler? Looking for potential graffiti spots nearby, huh?

dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here too. Looks like you're really talented, picking the most promising scenery like that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, well... not quite. So far, we've been pretty "feast or famine" when it comes to inspiration!

choices.text: Were you about to start working your magic here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that's true. We haven't seen graffiti in progress yet, have we? Could you show us?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Don't rush things. There are no suitable cliffs nearby — after all, avant-garde graffiti requires an avant-garde canvas!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I just happened to be passing through this area, and I recalled having a picnic here with a friend once, which is why I dropped by this spot again.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: If it wasn't for that friend's encouragement, I might have remained a tongue-tied, ordinary artist. Someone with no head for anything other than graffiti, unable to comprehend even the most basic of avant-garde philosophies.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: And of course, I'd never have met you two.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Sounds like you're talking about a dear friend who gave you important life advice!

choices.text: Like how Paimon and I travel together, then?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Well, I wouldn't say we're that close — you're almost joined at the hip, you know!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I met her many years ago, I was studying color mixing at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. It was the unique color scheme of her clothes that immediately drew my eye.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Other people would say that I look like someone whose soul's been torn out of their body when I think about colors and paints, and I didn't have many friends.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: But she thought differently. She believed that my "dopey-ness" was a sign that I was sure about my goals and wasn't concerned about anything else, just like a warrior in training.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: It wasn't any impassioned, encouraging speech, but she motivated me greatly just the same. We haven't kept in contact too much over the years, but I've never forgotten her words.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: She doesn't have any talent for graffiti, but that's fine. She became an awesome warrior all the same — in fact, I believe that someday, the Children of Echoes will all be proud of her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that's a new one... So friends who don't hang out often can encourage each other too!

choices.text: All the best to both of you.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Haha, don't you worry about that!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Danger and unexpected accidents are temporary. She'll be up and over those obstacles for sure!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: And I won't be standing idle either. There's always room to improve my graffiti skills, and I'm sure a breakthrough's on the horizon once I combine them with my latest thoughts on avant-garde art!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I'll paint something massive for her when she returns in triumph. Just watch me!

choices.text: I wish you both luck moving up in life!
Does your friend do graffiti as well?
Mind showing us your masterful artistry?
